description: This file defines the AccountEntityService interface within the org.apache.fineract.portfolio.self.pockets.service package. It declares methods related to account entity operations such as retrieving keys, validating user account mappings, and retrieving account numbers based on account IDs.

classes.name: AccountEntityService
classes.description: Interface for account entity operations related to self-service pockets in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns a string key related to the account entity, likely used as an identifier.

methods.name: validateSelfUserAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates the mapping of a self-registered user account by account ID.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account number associated with a given account ID.
